card.name: Space before a date or number
card.fires_on: The space token right after a comma or month name, just before a day, year or percentage figure. Also a few stray spots like "to" after "Want" and " RSS" after "&".

modes.label: Space before a date
modes.description: A blank space token after a weekday, month or comma, just ahead of the day or year.

modes.label: Space before a figure
modes.description: A blank space token after a comma in a drug name or citation, just ahead of a percentage or year.

modes.label: Stray web-text words
modes.description: A short word in web page headings or teasers.
modes.example: Want<< to>> stay on top of all the space news

card.plain: It fires on the blank space that comes just before a date or number in a list or citation.
